label: Game B
nuance_found: Real build and timing trade-offs: layer one tower with lettuce (range), tomato (damage), cheese (speed), bacon (burn), and 3 different layers make a CLUB (+25% everything). Calling the next wave early gives a combo bonus, burners (FLAME) and PEPPER and RINSE are timed active abilities, and the Sink punishes you with armoured Martini Knights so you must swap to Cheese Graters and rinse lanes back. Combo multiplier (x33, x74) rewards kills in a clump. Cheese Grater and Toaster only unlock later or in endless.
audio: Punchy cannon, thwip, pop and splurt on every shot with voiced olive barks in speech bubbles; jar-lid thud on the boss; wave ding. I never heard any music in the whole session.
furthest_progress: Midnight Snack endless: wave 10, THE JAR boss fight under way, score 29,910 at 540 s with 20/20 bites left. Also: The Cutting Board 3 stars (12,430), The Stovetop cleared (1 star, 34,480, beat THE JAR), The Sink lost at wave 6 and wave 8 (best 5,270). 4 of 15 stars.
control_trouble: A few mis-taps: swatting near a tower opens its upgrade menu, and the menu stacks over the swat target. Otherwise taps were enough.
best_moment: Combo x74 on The Stovetop, burners lit and pepper blast clearing a whole lane while the jar boss lost his lid.
worst_moment: The Sink armoured knights ate my lunch twice with no real counter unlocked, and there was no music at all.
verdict: This is the one I would keep. I knew what to do in 20 seconds, the score tells me exactly what to chase (combo multiplier, early-wave bonus, stars and orders per level), and every level has a new toy: burners, rinse, pepper. Calling waves early is a real risk-for-reward line, and the Sink made me change my build. The endless Midnight Snack is the mode I would grind for a score. Minus points for no music and a hard difficulty spike on level 3, but I want another run.
